preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns n must be between 3 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == n and all(len(line) == n for line in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must consist of n lines, each containing exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for line in stdout for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be either 'W' (white knight) or 'B' (black knight).
The number of duels in the output must be the maximum possible for the given board size.
